questions.q: What does "Closed for Receiving" mean for a purchase order?
options: The purchase order has been cancelled entirely
No invoicing has happened yet
No further receiving activity is expected, though invoicing may still occur
The purchase order was rejected during approval
questions.explain: Closed for Receiving specifically means receiving activity is done, while invoicing (such as a final invoice) might still be outstanding.

questions.q: What does "Finally Closed" represent in the purchase order status lifecycle?
options: The very first status assigned when a PO is created
A status that automatically reopens after 30 days
A temporary status used only during approval
The true end-of-life status, reached once all receiving and invoicing activity is complete and the PO is eligible to be archived
questions.explain: Finally Closed is the end-of-life status, indicating all receiving and invoicing activity is fully complete.

questions.q: How does Cancelled differ fundamentally from Closed?
options: Closed assumes the order was fulfilled as intended; Cancelled means the order (or part of it) will never be fulfilled at all
They are two names for the exact same outcome
Cancelled can only be applied to requisitions, never purchase orders
Closed always happens before approval, Cancelled always happens after
questions.explain: Closing reflects completed fulfillment; cancelling means fulfillment will not happen at all, which is a fundamentally different outcome.

questions.q: Why is cancelling a purchase order line that already has a receipt or invoice against it restricted or complicated?
options: Because such lines are automatically deleted overnight
Because reversing financial activity that has already occurred is not as simple as just marking the document cancelled
Because only the original requester can ever cancel a line
Because Oracle Fusion does not allow any purchase order to ever be cancelled
questions.explain: Once real receiving or invoicing activity has occurred, cancellation requires special handling because that financial activity cannot simply be erased.

questions.q: What is the expected ending status for LTV's bearing purchase order in this course's main (non-exception) scenario?
options: Finally Closed, after the full quantity is received and the invoice is matched and paid
Cancelled, because Meridian could not fulfill the order
Open, indefinitely, with no further action
Closed for Receiving only, with invoicing never completing
questions.explain: Since the full 50 units are received and the invoice is matched and paid in this clean scenario, the PO progresses naturally to Finally Closed.
